accepted_inputs: Only the independently pinned and audited v20.0 and v20.1 all-domain collections and exact selected-commit LICENSE.txt; v20.1 remains the primary baseline.
version_dates: Catalog version from agreeing locked release tag and each collection x_mitre_version. source_as_of is locked release published_at, never max(object.modified). built_at is explicit UTC at or after source_as_of; cutoff and major release date are independent fields.
digest_subjects: Source hashes cover exact downloaded bytes, including license. Builder hash covers exact retained executable bytes. Source profile hash covers exact eventual frozen profile bytes; candidate index binds every proposal file separately. Runtime manifest/payload/JCS framing follow adopted successor owner, not this candidate index.
object_identity: Source-stable STIX id. The source field preserves all encountered typed properties, including original id, human ATT&CK IDs, external references, lifecycle, aliases and structured metadata. Source object and relationship schemas are closed. Values and array order are preserved without URL or text rewriting.
normalization: Native parsed values, arrays and optional presence are exact. Common display fields normalize CRLF/CR to LF, trim using RP-REQ-118 and apply NFC. Empty or absent description is null. No truncation. Lookup aliases use NFC then ASCII folding, with every ambiguous key excluded across all objects and lifecycle states.
omissions_nulls: Native optional STIX members preserve absence. Native present values retain their exact parsed types, never coerce null to empty. Wrapper members are all required, extensions exactly {}, embedded relationship source exactly null. Source schemas do not insert defaults. No opaque untyped extensions.
duplicates: Across domains coalesce only byte-identical JCS source objects with agreeing id/version and retain every source locator. Within-domain repeated ID, cross-domain same-ID difference or unresolved reference fails. No domain wins by order.
relationship_construction: Direct STIX SROs preserve direction, description, citations, original relationship id and lifecycle. Resolve direct kill_chain_phases membership only by unique (domain, tactic shortname); matrix tactic_refs retain array order; strategy analytic_refs and analytic data_component_ref edges retain exact array-item locators and log descriptors. No transitive edge assertions. Named related_assets lack STIX references: retain structured metadata without inventing identities or graph edges. Creator, modifier, marking and collection references remain native provenance; do not expose them as threat assertions. Embedded source and target types are mandatory; missing endpoints, incorrect native categories, and ambiguous tactic resolution fail content_semantic_invalid. Retirement alone does not invalidate permitted endpoints.
relationship_identity: RP-REQ-111 unchanged. One edge per direct embedded property occurrence, coalescing identical cross-domain copies only. Source artifact order is fixed before locators and relationship IDs. Distinct occurrences with the same endpoints remain distinct.
ordering: RP-REQ-102: object rows sort by object_id; relationship rows by relationship_type, source_object_id, target_object_id, relationship_id, all ascending UTF-8 bytes. The three bundle source_artifacts use official asset URLs as source_ref, catalog version as source_version, exact SHA-256, and sort by source_ref, source_version, sha256 under Table 8-C. The license is a retained build input and declared notice, not an object source artifact. Preserve native array order; member serialization uses existing RFC8785 JCS; NDJSON ends each row with LF. Canonical source_refs sort artifact_index then locator. Deterministic uncompressed ustar only after adoption.
licensing: Use exact selected-commit LICENSE.txt as notices/MITRE-ATTACK.txt with LicenseRef-MITRE-ATTACK and its notice binding. The MITRE Corporation grants non-exclusive royalty-free research, development and commercial use when copies retain its copyright designation and complete license. The project user directed adoption of this MITRE-issued license on 2026-11-08. Production output policy must bind the exact lock and this profile, preserve the complete notice including disclaimers, and record the distribution decision. This is reliance on the published license, not a claim of MITRE endorsement or bespoke product approval. Fixture authority remains separate and restricted.
lifecycle: Generic deprecated = revoked OR x_mitre_deprecated, absent flags treated false. Preserve original flags independently; no current-only filter. Evaluate SRO lifecycle independently and retain retired endpoints and valid replacements.
provenance: Native object rows include collection, identity and marking-definition. Collection inventory object_ref/object_modified remains typed and ordered; entire original bundles and their framing remain source evidence outside the runtime pack. No encountered source object category or property is excluded.

limits.rationale: Adopted native limits, checked against complete augmented canonical rows; no truncation.

network: Only source acquisition can access the network. Assembly, envelope production and verification use retained local inputs.

canonical_projection.display_label: Trimmed NFC source.name; marking-definition uses MITRE ATT&CK marking plus source.id. Never truncate.
canonical_projection.description: CRLF/CR to LF, RP-REQ-118 trimming, NFC; null for absent or empty. Preserve original source.description.
canonical_projection.aliases: sorted unambiguous normalized source aliases and x_mitre_aliases; empty array when none
canonical_projection.deprecated: OR(revoked,x_mitre_deprecated); missing flags treated false; preserve original optional flags.
canonical_projection.replacement_object_id: target of active direct revoked-by SRO if unique; null otherwise; reject self, cycle, missing target, chain >32; require generic deprecated=true when replacement exists
canonical_projection.external_refs: source citations with real nonempty external_id only; retain canonical HTTPS/no-fragment URL unchanged when already conformant, otherwise url=null; original complete citations always native in source.external_references
canonical_projection.source_refs: all source-artifact indexes and /objects/index JSON pointers; embedded edges use exact property/item pointers
canonical_projection.source_domains: sorted set of contributing bundle domains, separately from original x_mitre_domains
canonical_projection.relationship_type: original SRO relationship_type; embedded predicates has-tactic, member-of-tactic, has-analytic, uses-data-component
canonical_projection.source_object_id: original SRO source_ref; embedded reference containing object id
canonical_projection.target_object_id: original SRO target_ref; embedded referenced object id or uniquely resolved named tactic
canonical_projection.relationship_description: SRO description normalized without truncation, null for embedded edges; original procedure text remains native

direct_embedded_predicates.direction: technique to unique tactic matching domain/shortname

direct_embedded_predicates.order: source.x_mitre_log_source_references retains name/channel/j; no component to technique assertion

generic_projection.data: Complete canonical predecessor source-model record, including its inert schema_id; no source fields discarded.
generic_projection.object_identity: Preserve source-model object_id or entry_id exactly.
generic_projection.source_references: Preserve ordered source_refs and their manifest source-artifact bindings.
generic_projection.validation_owner: Producer-owned source-model schema and semantic checks run before generic encoding. Runtime interprets only the generic envelope and descriptor.

license_conditions: Retain the complete pinned MITRE license, copyright designation and disclaimers with every pack copy and embedded pack.
Refer to MITRE ATT&CK® by its proper name; do not imply MITRE affiliation, sponsorship or endorsement.
Do not relicense the MITRE content as project-owned content.
